description: This file defines the InputStream class within the AWS CRT PHP SDK, providing an interface to work with input streams at a lower-level native resource abstraction. It extends NativeResource and offers methods for EOF checking, reading, seeking, and obtaining stream length.

classes.name: InputStream
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates a native input stream, providing methods to read data, seek within the stream, and check for EOF status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the input stream with a given PHP stream, setting up native options and resources.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that releases native resources associated with the input stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream based on offset and basis.
